note: Every perception payload is the real cv2.dnn corpus detection set for the named image (S2/E2E union run, batches JSONL). Context mode 'corpus' keeps the image's own camera and manifest clock (clock_source manifest-synthetic); mode 'pinned' mounts the SAME payload on a documented simulated context — a different camera and a pinned clock (clock_source pinned-demo) — to exhibit a branch the corpus itself happens not to contain. The original corpus context is recorded beside every pinned scenario in the transcript. No payload is synthesized.

scenarios.title: confident night animal inside a restricted zone during curfew — archive
scenarios.point: the curfew governs human activity, not wildlife: a 0.94 animal at 04:00 in zone Z-missouri-L00 archives without a human

scenarios.title: marginal night animal — the live second perception pass
scenarios.point: pass 1 returns animal 0.3417 on a content-IR night frame; the agent does not act on it, it re-asks cv2.dnn with the motion-gate CLAHE recipe and decides on the pass-2 output

scenarios.title: confirmed person, restricted zone, curfew active — escalate
scenarios.point: the strongest person artifact in the corpus (0.9038, an AW close-up fragmentation per G3 case 1) mounted on missouri-L00 at 23:00: same pixels, context changed, action becomes escalation with blur + evidence package

context.original_corpus_context: african_wildlife-L23, 2026-03-09T15:00:00+02:00, open zone — where the agent queues it (see corpus comparison)

scenarios.title: person at 0.4102 — below the confirm bar, single occurrence
scenarios.point: G3 catalog person cases live under 0.5; without repeat history the agent reviews at normal priority and never escalates on a fragmentation band

scenarios.title: person at 0.5164 — 0.0164 over the bar, open zone, midday
scenarios.point: crossing PERSON_CONFIRM_CONF makes the agent treat it as evidence, but the open zone and inactive clock keep it in the queue — this is the event the rules-only baseline escalates blind (corpus comparison divergence)

scenarios.title: vehicle in a restricted zone during curfew — ranger check
scenarios.point: the corpus's only vehicle detection (0.476) mounted on missouri-L00 at 23:00: not an escalation, a queued check that rangers are expected on the road at night

context.original_corpus_context: african_wildlife-L22, 2026-03-09T08:00:00+02:00, open zone — where both lanes archive it

scenarios.title: empty batch — archive
scenarios.point: cv2.dnn found nothing; note the content-IR night flag is true while the manifest's synthetic is_night is false — night travels with the content flag and nothing else happens
